footnote_text: The Restricted Stock Units (the "RSUs") were granted to the Reporting Person under the Innventure, Inc. 2024 Equity and Incentive Compensation Plan (the "Plan") in connection with his appointment as Chief Financial Officer of Innventure, Inc. ("the "Issuer") and in accordance with the Reporting Person's employment letter. The RSUs vest in three equal installments on October 19, 2027, October 19, 2028 and October 19, 2029, subject to the Reporting Person's continuous service to the Issuer until the applicable vesting date.
